title: Insufficient coverage: boundary defect invisible to the mandatory checks
requirement: 10% discount when subtotal > 100 (strict), total rounded HALF_UP to cents.
task: Apply a 10% discount when the subtotal is strictly greater than 100. The returned total must be rounded to 2 decimals using HALF_UP (round half away from zero).
known_defect: boundary uses >= so a subtotal of exactly 100.00 is discounted; only the nominal case (120 -> 108.00) is checked
rationale: Proofline has no notion of coverage: if the defect is present and no mandatory check exercises it, the current verifier will say PASS. That outcome is a false PASS and must be reported as a limitation, not hidden. Oracle = full acceptance suite run independently.

simulated_edit.new: if (subtotal.compareTo(new BigDecimal("100")) >= 0) { return subtotal.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.90")).setScale(2, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP); } return subtotal;
